messages.subject: model formulation
parts:
Hi, I have a model like this (in lme4a syntax):

m = lmer(expression ~ exposure * (asthma + atopy) + gender + (1|
subject) + (1|batch), data=df)

I am trying to understand how to put that in ez syntax. I've tried,
among other things, this:

ezANOVA(data=df, dv=.(expression), wid=.(batch), within=.(exposure,
atopy, asthma, gender), type=3)

Gives an error about "One or more cells is missing data..." which is
not the case. How can I specify this correctly?


thanks,
-Brent

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] model formulation
parts:
Your lmer model has 2 random effects, which ANOVA can't handle. Were
you possibly intending to use ezMixed (the ez interface to mixed
effects modelling)? If so, the syntax would be:

my_mix = ezMixed(
data = df
, dv = .(expression)
, random = .(subject,batch)
, fixed = .(exposure,asthma,atopy,gender)
)
print(my_mix$summary)
